Stable Factor status is read-only and non-authorizing; it replaces mutable health-driven weight decay and deprecation with explicit blocked evidence.
Stable Factor verification reads canonical inputs and reports status without registry mutation; obsolete health automation and apply routes are absent.
SystemStore owns immutable objects and the only generation CAS; the removed Factor-specific WAL, registry CAS, rollback, and activation protocol are not a second authority.
Stable bootstrap, prospective, statistical, and non-authorizing status contracts replace the legacy Factor governance protocol; legacy writer and receipt taxonomies are not retained.
Stable statistical admission and non-authorizing status replace the retired quality envelope while preserving exact threshold and fail-closed behavior.
Readiness is now a compiled non-authorizing artifact stored through the immutable SystemStore object boundary; the standalone readiness installer is removed.
Compiled exact artifacts and immutable SystemStore objects replace mutable Factor registry patch, journal, rollback, and record-level CAS behavior.

Stable status reports are read-only and non-authorizing, and observed prospective evidence remains separate from active bootstrap state; mutable deprecation proposals and registry-write CLI routes are not retained.
Exact bootstrap signal computation and prospective preregistration replace implementation-name dispatch through retired health records.
Immutable kind-scoped objects and an idempotent pre-CAS migration receipt replace the one-off non-authoritative closure writer and its private readback format.

The incident-specific forensic receipt, inert same-epoch plan, numeric research history, builder, and compatibility wrapper are intentionally removed. Stable provider replay retains generic one-value blocking, restatement detection, and resealed-output rejection, but is not claimed as a full forensic replacement.
The stable provider-evidence package preserves exact window planning, physical receipts, logical coverage, raw-byte identity, and offline package boundaries.
The stable unversioned partition executor preserves exact scope closure, terminal fail-closed behavior, full schedule policy, and private checkpoint replay without fallback or activation.
The stable generation promoter preserves read-only preflight, exact CAS, rollback, race, and filesystem-integrity behavior without the retired journal protocol.
Stable provider replay preserves sealed policy, winner selection, exact source-only shape, canonical multiset identity, reconciliation closure, and durable filesets.

Stable partition acquisition and provider-evidence closure preserve exact private source binding and replay. Frozen shadow-bundle, derived-table, and staging-generation emission are intentionally not retained as authority.
Prospective preregistration now locks the exact evidence contract and observations; unready or unbound exposure evidence remains terminal instead of being inferred.
Stable statistics require the complete finite matrix, all canonical CPCV splits, and the exact admission boundary, failing closed on insufficient observations.
The sealed prospective contract and exact observation inputs replace mutable mining contexts that propagated exposure maps and dynamically narrowed buckets.
Stable redundancy components, complete-matrix PBO, and exact conjunctive admission replace mutable effective-trial and qualification records.
Prospective preregistration binds the exact ordered open sessions and stable cohort rules; the separate calendar adapter and path-discovery surface are removed.
Stable transitive redundancy and exact admission evidence replace pool-relative residual ranking while preserving rejection of clone-like candidates.
Immutable exact objects, single-pointer CAS, prepublication stops, and filesystem hardening replace the retired Factor replay publisher and apply surface.
Stable preregistration seals exact sessions, one selected signal, at most one locked alternate, and fixed roles without generated variants or editable trial counts.
The stable semantic preregistration artifact preserves deterministic encoding and the single-alternate limit without retaining a numeric catalog surface.
The stable Factor surface admits only exact compiled bootstrap definitions and prospective candidates, replacing prefix-based implementation allowlisting.
Exact prospective source bindings, real-symbol observations, terminal coverage, and non-authorizing status replace compatibility acceptance of legacy exposure sources.
Exact bootstrap roles and sealed prospective selection replace inference from a mutable production set; the control factor remains permanently non-selectable.
Stable prospective observations and statistical admission retain the supported research evidence boundaries; direct mining-to-registry writers and bulk family mutation are removed.
Sealed first-session selection, exact observations, and terminal coverage failure replace the retired weighted shadow arm and mutable observation ledger.

The one-off five-record mutable-registry migration, its numeric schema, and its equal-weight production claim are intentionally removed; bootstrap is an exact two-factor non-authorizing exception, not a replay of that migration.
The generic pinned research-formula production runtime is intentionally removed; stable Factor computation exposes only the exact bootstrap formulas and sealed prospective configurations.
The standalone residual-baseline schema and generic formula execution helpers are intentionally removed; prospective artifacts bind a fixed neutralization contract without retaining that runtime API.

The stable shadow script preserves pure dry-run closure validation, injectable paced acquisition, checkpoint replay, and official reconciliation with no activation. Legacy evidence-bundle, derived-table, staging-generation, and package-hash emission are intentionally removed.

The stable upgrade script preserves closure and scope preflight while explicitly blocking execute without unified System activation. Legacy market pointer and journal promotion are intentionally removed.
The stable authority boundary preserves offline purity, injected live transport, exact private artifacts, filesystem hardening, and a token-free public surface.
Stable capability probes and exact data contracts preserve replayable receipt chains, terminal classifications, endpoint separation, and pre-transport retry refusal.
The stable transport decimal suite preserves compatible default decoding, strict decimal and integer identity, sentinel normalization, finite-value enforcement, and explicit response limits.
Stable exact endpoint plans, policies, request receipts, schema receipts, and decimal response projections replace the numeric execution-plan contract.
The stable membership script preserves pure dry-run behavior, injected live capture, exact partition persistence, and replay-based resume without fallback.
Stable industry capture preserves exact official cardinality, three-call taxonomy closure, membership partition planning, one-request captures, and resealed-forgery rejection.
The stable taxonomy script preserves pure dry-run behavior, exact private replayable files, injected live transport, and controlled contract blockers.

The stable unversioned official plan preserves the current semantic topology, compact replay, exact fields, and schedule-forgery rejection. Historical numeric builder branches are intentionally removed.
Stable schema diagnostics and exact data contracts preserve no-transport dry runs, injected capture, stable receipts, one-plan enforcement, and closed schema refs.
Stable theme capture preserves complete keysets, provider-separated projections, exact refs, replay, and fail-closed scope handling. Legacy compiler authority is removed.
The stable theme script preserves zero-write dry runs, exact injected capture, replay resume, and registry-first failure before company requests.
The stable transport suite enforces the exact official HTTPS root, default TLS, endpoint allowlisting before sockets, token admission, closed responses, no override surface, and no filesystem writes.
Compiled versionless contracts, deterministic migration custody, and SystemStore object/generation verification replace the legacy package, boundary, cleanup, and storage contract tests.
The legacy executable or live provider/storage producer is outside stable Intelligence and System; stable runtime consumes exact immutable refs and performs no inferred acquisition fallback.
Stable evaluate, compile-evidence, inspect, identity, and fail-closed stage semantics replace the numeric forward/fusion/scoring taxonomies; all outputs remain inactive.
